# Openers & Closers

> > Manufacturer of professional door closure systems, electric strikes, magnetic contacts, and access control hardware for security applications.

Openers & Closers specializes in electric strikes (Series 3, 5, 8, 9), magnetic contacts (CMI, CMB, CMC, CME series), and access control components including the AC330 keypad. The company develops security-grade hardware with certifications for smoke resistance, fail-secure/fail-safe operation, and protection against RFID vulnerabilities.

## Key Topics

- Electric Strikes
- Magnetic Contacts
- Access Control
- Series 5
- Series 3
- Series 9
- ABS Plastic
- Security Grade 3
- Fail-Secure/Fail-Safe
- AC330 Keypad
- RFID Protection
- Mifare Classic 1k
- Recess-Mounted
- Surface-Mounted
- Door Hardware

## Electric Strikes

- [Series 5 Electric Strike 5US Universal Security](https://www.openers-closers.com/en/electric-strikes/5/5us): 5US universal security electric strike, fail-secure/safe, multivoltage
- [Series 3 Electric Strike 3UK Universal Smoke Resistant](https://www.openers-closers.com/en/electric-strikes/3/3uk): 3UK universal smoke-resistant electric strike, fail-secure, multi-voltage
- [Serie 9 Cerradero Electrónico 9E Electrónico Estándar](https://www.openers-closers.com/es/cerraderos-electricos/9/9e): 9E electronic strike for security doors, 10-30V AC/DC variable voltage
